tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// phywa 'phrin nor bu mchog rgyal gyi g.yang skyob cho ga 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ legs pa'i dpal kun g.yang du 'gugs pa la// sdang ba 'dul byed dus 'dir rgyal kun las// thugs rje rmad byung mtsho skyes rdo rje dang*// dbyer med gsang ba'i bdag pos rtag tu srungs// rab brling kañca na yi lhun po la// nyin byed 'od kyis bklubs par co 'dri'i sku// sgeg cing dpa' ba'i gzi brjid lham me ba// dpal ldan rnam thos bu yis dge legs stsol// gang la brten nas srid zhi'i phun tshogs g.yang*// mos pa'i khang par ci yang 'gugs byed pa'i// phrin las nor bu mchog gi rgyal po zhes// mtsho skyes gsung gi byin rlabs 'od du 'bar// de lta na yang legs gsungs rgyu spun bzang*// 'khrugs bsdebs thags su bskrun la mkhas min phal// bon gyer gos su gyon pa'i zlos gar gyis// blo ldan yid dbang 'phrog 'dod gad mo'i rgyu// des na 'di la 'jug rnams yid ches phyir// sngon byung zhus lan tshul gyis gsungs pa las// rjes su 'jug pa'i nyams len bsdebs pa la// chos bdag srung ma'i tshogs kyis gnang ba stsol// de la snyigs dus 'dir rgyal ba gnyis pa lta bu thugs rje'i bdag nyid/ slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bho ṭa'i ljongs kyi skye 'gro dbul ba'i sdug bsngal las bskyabs shing mngon mtho nges legs kyi bde 'byor spel ba'i phyir/ gter kha du mar g.yang skyob kyi cho ga sbas pa las/ 'dir byang gter rig 'dzin rgod ldem can gyi phyag tu byung ba rin chen khang bu'i man ngag them med du gtogs pa phywa phrin nor bu mchog rgyal gyi cho ga nyams su bstar ba'i tshul la/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ bkra shis pa'i nyi ma la sogs par yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi sku dang*/

khyad par phyag na rdo rje dang rnam sras gtso 'khor gyi rten bkram pa'i mdun gyi stegs bu'i steng du/ phywa gzhi glang po che yi pags pa dngos sam/ ras la glang lpags kyi rnam pa bris pa'i dbus su gling bzhi gling phran lcags ri'i mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa bkram/ bsdu na gzhi ma dkar po'i steng du nas dkar gyi tshom bu dgu bkod pas kyang rung ngo*// de'i steng gi rgyab phyogs tsam du man 'ji la sogs pa'i khar snod gcig tu zan leb gru bzhi pa'i steng gi dbus su mkhar thabs che ba gcig phyogs mtshams brgyad du mkhar thabs chung ngu brgyad la mar gyi rgyan ci mdzes dang*/ 'byor na gtso 'khor rnams kyi tsa ka li gzugs/ mtha' skor kun du nor bu mig gsum lta bu'i zan ril sum brtsegs ci mang gis bskor ba dang*/ de'i mdun ngos tsam du rin po che'i snod du 'bru sna tshogs pa'i phye las byas pa'i zan gyi ri rab gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa/ de'i khar nor bu zur brgyad pas brgyan cing rtsa bar tshe ril gyis bskor ba la smug rtsis byugs pa la mar gyi rtse rgyan nyi zla nor bus spras pa/ ri rab kyi bang rim dang po la ne'u le nor bu skyugs pa dang*/ gzhan rnams su bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ nor bu cha bdun sogs ci mdzes byas pa la mda' dar dmar po me long can gzugs/ de'i shar du rgyun 'bab kyi chus bkang ba'i snod/ lhor ri bkra bzang po'i sa dang byin rlabs can gyi sa sna/ nub tu tsan+dan dmar po'am shug pa'i sdong bu can gyi mar me/ byang du rlung g.yab dkar po ste 'byung bzhi'i bcud dgug pa'i rdzas bzhi/ mtshams bzhir bcud dgug pa'i zhal zas bzhi/ lho nub tu rin po che'i bum pa'am dkar yol lam rdza sogs kyi bum pa skyon med pa/ chang bzang po la bu ram sbrang sogs chos sman btab pa'i nang du/

mar gyi nor bu cha bdun la sogs pa nor bu'i rigs kha dog sna tshogs byas pa dang*/ nas dang gro'i dbyibs can dang*/ dud 'gro'i sna 'ju sogs kyi gzugs brnyan bcos pa blugs la/ kha phye mar dang mar khus bcad pa la rdo rje rgya gram bris pas bkab pa'i steng du/ zan gyi nor bu mig gsum bkod pa'i phywa bum bzhag byang shar nas shar lho'i bar du yi dam gyi gtor ma dang*/ snod cig tu dbus su gtso bo'i dzam bshos che ba gcig la/ dzam bha la yab yum la gnyis/ rta bdag brgyad la re re/ klu rnams la thun mong du gcig sde dpon stobs chen bcas la gcig dus bzhi lha mo la gcig ste dzam bshos bcu gsum gyis bskor ba/ yang na gtso 'khor thams cad la dzam bshos gcig gis kyang thus so// 'byung bzhi'i lha la 'brang rgyas zlum po dkar po/ gru bzhi ser po/ gru gsum dmar po/ zla gam ljang gu rnams shar nas rim par phyogs bzhir bkod/ rgyal chen bzhi la phyogs bzhir cog zlum re re'am/ bsdu na mdun du gcig phyogs skyong dang sde brgyad gnyis la cog zlum re rnams mdun nas rim par bsgrigs/ logs su phywa glud kyi gtor ma gnyis kyang bsham/ de dag gi mtha' skor du nyer spyod rnams g.yas skor du gru bzhir bsham/ gzhan yang phye mar dang bre nas dkar gyis bkang ba la mda' dar me long gis brgyan pa gzugs/ g.yab dar du dkar mo lag g.yas la mda' dar dmar po me long gis brgyan pa dang*/ 'og tu dgos pa'i tshogs la mdzo tol dang rmig zlum gyi sha dang chang ma gtogs pa'i yo byad gang 'byor rnams dang*/ gzhan yang gser dngul sogs rin po che yi rigs dang*/ gos dar/ go khrab/ dkar mngar shing thog gi rigs/ dgon sde dang bla ma lta bu la/ rdo rje dril bu/ glegs bam/ dung dkar sogs kyang gang 'byor dang*/ yi dam gu ru zhi drag lta bu yin na de la dgos pa'i sman rag gtor ma sogs ma tshang ba med par bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la yi dam gyi phrin las dang*/

phywa g.yang gi phrin las gnyis las/ dang po yi dam ni phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can nam gu ru zhi drag la sogs pa'i phrin las kyi gzhung sogs sam gshin rje gshed sogs gang rung ste/ khyad par rang gis dbang thob cing bsnyen pa sogs sngon du song ba'i yi dam gal che bas de'i bdag mdun mchod gtor rnams sngon du btang ba ste/ de'ang phyi ma rnams ni so so'i yi ger shes par bya zhing*/ 'dir mchog tu shis pa phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can la mos pa rnams ni 'di ltar nyams su blang bar bya ste/ thog mar mchod pa'i yo byad rnams dri bzang gi chus gtor la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i nye bar spyod pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang thun mong khyad par gyi mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas shap+da āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i bar rol mo dang bcas pas byin dbab bo// de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// mkhyen brtse nus gter bla ma lha// dkon mchog gsum dang srung ma'i tshogs// kun la rtag par skyabs su mchi// zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro lan gsum mam bdun dang*/ sems bskyed pa ni/ srid pa'i mtsho las skye bo rnams// gdon phyir byang chub thob par bya// de rgyu phyag na rdo rje yi// rnal 'byor nyams su blang bya'o// zhes pa lan gsum/ bdag lhar bskyed pa ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ gis stong par sbyangs/ chos rnams rang bzhin stong par gyur// stong pa'i rang rtsal paṃ dang a'i// yi ge las byung pad+ma zlar// rang sems ngo bo hūm̐ mthing las// rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte bar hūm̐// 'bar ba'i 'od zer phyogs bcur song*// 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro don mdzad// slar 'dus phyag mtshan sa bon bcas// yongs su gyur las bdag nyid ni// rgyal ba kun dngos gsang ba'i bdag

/sku mdog an+da rnyil ltar sngo// phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga mkhar// gdengs pas steng gdon skrag mdzad cing*// g.yon pas thugs khar sdigs mdzub kyis// 'og gdon la sogs gdug pa 'dul// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'gying bag can// spyan gsum sdang mig g.yo zhing blta// zhal gdangs mche dkar gangs ri'i phreng*// ljags dmar glog gi gar mkhan rtse// thun mtshams sprin gyis byugs pa'i skra// sma ra smin ma 'khyog cing 'bar// sku stod dar sngon gyis mdzes shing*// stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs dang*// rin chen rgyan dang klu brgyad kyis// mdzes dang mi sdug gnyis su byas// ye shes me chen 'bar ba'i klong*// gar gyi nyams dgu rdzogs gyur pa'i// gnas gsum oṃ dang āḥhūm̐ mtshan// snying ga'i sa bon 'od zer gyis// lcang lo can nas rdo rje 'dzin// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams// tshur spyon badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la bstim// de bzhin rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyang*// tshur spyon badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ /bdag la mngon par dbang bskur cig /des kyang badz+ra pā ṇi kaḥ /a bhi ṣiñca mi zhes gsung*// dbang bskur sgo gsum dri ma sbyangs// spyi bor mi bskyod mgon pos brgyan// bzlas pa bya ba ni/ thugs ka'i zla bar hūm̐ dang sngags// bkod pa'i 'od kyis 'phags pa mchod// gdon bgegs gdug pa tshar bcad de// 'phags pa'i thugs rjes bdag byin brlabs// zhes brjod cing*/ oṃ nī lam+bā ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar/ spro na/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ shap+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni// lcang lo can gyi pho brang na// gdug pa can rnams dul mdzad pa// gos sngon can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod cing bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/

myur du phyag na rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes brjod/ de nas gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ khaṃ las byung ba'i lha'i zhal zas dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na n+wata/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hās bdud rtsir byas/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhiḥlo tsā sarba ar+tha ni swā hā dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas rgya cher spel lo// mdun gyi sku la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ chos rnams rang bzhin stong par gyur/ sogs nas/ spyi bor mi bskyod mgon pos brgyan zhes pa'i bar/ rang sems kyi tshab tu ye shes dang*/ bdag nyid la de nyid dang*/ bdag la/ 'di la bsgyur ba ma gtogs 'dra'o// thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ ni lam+bā ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi radz+nyā pa ya ti/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta gṛh+ṇa tu/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo ghā ya swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas/ gong ltar mchod cing bstod pa'i mthar/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la// bdag cag yon sbyor 'khor bcas la// tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel// sku gsum lhun gyis grub par mdzod// ces brjod do// gnyis pa phywa g.yang gi phrin las gyer pa la lnga las/ dang po phywa glud btang ba ni/ phywa glud kyi gtor ma dang po bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phywa glud kyi gtor ma 'dod dgu phun sum tshogs pa'i rgya mtsho gyur par bsams la/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal po chen po bzhi oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ tsa turma hā ra dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dha rmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+nu sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ gtor ma gnyis pa byin brlabs sngar bzhin dang*/

slar yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ phywa khu ye/ shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung*// dri za gshin rje'i rgyal po ste// shar phyogs khams la dbang gis bsgyur// rje blon btsun mo 'khor du bcas// phywa glud bzang po 'di bzhes la// phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir khug cig /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir phob cig /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir skyobs shig /lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po// grul bum pho mo'i rgyal po ste// lho phyogs khams la dbang gis bsgyur// rje blon btsun mo 'khor du bcas// phywa glud bzang po 'di bzhes la// phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang*// klu dang bdud kyi rgyal po ste// nub phyogs khams la dbang gis bsgyur// rje dang btsun mo 'khor du bcas// phywa glud bzang po= /phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras// gnod sbyin sha za'i rgyal po ste// byang phyogs khams la dbang gis bsgyur// rje dang btsun mo 'khor du bcas// phywa glud bzang po= /phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /steng phyogs tshangs pa brgya byin sogs// lha chen brgyad po thams cad de// steng phyogs lha yi tshogs bcas rnams// phywa glud bzang po= /phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /'og phyogs dga' bo 'jog po sogs// sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad de// 'og phyogs gnas pa'i tshogs bcas rnams// phywa glud bzang po= /phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir=

/bar snang nyi zla rgyu skar dang*// gza' dang gdon mo gzer sman sogs// bar snang gnas pa'i tshogs bcas rnams// phywa glud bzang po= /phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /phyogs mtshams bdud dmu rgyal po btsan// srin po 'byung po ma mo dang*// g.ya' sman gangs sman mtsho sman dang*// yul phyogs 'dir gnas gzhi bdag dang*// dam sri gdon bgegs thams cad rnams// phywa glud bzang po= /phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir skyobs shig /ces pa'i gtor ma bsngos nas phrin las bcol lo// gnyis pa phywa rdzas bsang ba ni/ bgegs gtor cig la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs te/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥsogs kyis bsngos la/ rdo rje dril bu thogs te 'di skad du/ hūm̐ gsang chen sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// dngos grub stsol phyir 'du 'gyur ba'i// lha dang srung ma ma gtogs pa'i// dngos grub bar du gcod byed pa'i// gdon bgegs 'byung po khyed cag rnams// mchod sbyin gtor mas tshim gyis la// ma 'tshe bar ni gzhan du dengs// ci ste mi 'gro 'dug byed na// bde gshegs kun 'du thugs gnyis med// ye shes khro bo'i 'phro 'du yis// bgegs dpung thams cad rdul phran bzhin// 'thags 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// ces brjod cing rol mo dang bcas te/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs dang*/ yi dam gyi sngags dang yungs thun brdeg cing mtshams gcad do// gsum pa phywa sgo bsdam pa ni/ shar gyi sgo ma lcags kyu ma// dkar mo zhi ba'i las la brtson// dung gi sgo mo bsdams nas kyang*// phywa dang g.yang du 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /lho yi sgo ma zhags pa na// ser mo rgyas pa'i las la brtson// gser gyi sgo mo bsdams nas kyang*// phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir=

/dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /nub kyi sgo ma lcags sgrog ma// dmar mo dbang gi las la brtson// zangs kyi sgo mo bsdams nas kyang*// phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /byang gi sgo ma dril bu ma// sngon mo drag po'i las la brtson// g.yu yi sgo mo bsdams nas kyang*// phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// zhes pa'i sgo ma bzhi la las bcol/ bzhi pa phywa 'gugs pa'i lha sgrub cing mchod pa ni/ mdun gyi bris sku rten gtor dang bcas pa la dmigs te/ phywa khu ye/ chos kun rang bzhin ma grub kyang*// rang gdangs ma 'gags yi ge bh+rūm̐// 'od zer lnga ldan las grub pa'i// rnam thos sras kyi pho brang che// gser gyi rgyal mtshan can zhes pa// blta na sdug pa'i gzhal med khang*// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bcas// shar shel lho phyogs bai ḍū r+ya// nub phyogs rā ga byang phyogs gser// phyi nang rin chen ka ba ni// nyis stong lnga brgyas bteg pa la// pho brang sum brtsegs rgya phibs ldan// nor bu 'bar ba'i tog gis spras// mu tig drwa ba drwa phyed dang*// mda' yab pu shus mdzes par brgyan// gter gyi khang pa bco lngas bskor// 'khor sa rim pa gsum bskor nas// 'khor sa nang ma'i khyams dag la// pho brang chen po'i phyogs mtshams su// rta bdag brgyad kyi khang brtsegs brgyad// rin chen rgyan tshogs stug pos brgyan// de yi phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad na// gter gyi khang pa bzang po brgyad// dpag bsam rin chen ljon shing brgyad// 'dod yon rdzing bu rin chen spras// me tog kha dog sna tshogs bkra// chu bya sna tshogs skad snyan sgrogs// 'dod 'jo'i ba la sogs pa yi// dgos 'dod kun 'byung lha yi gnas// phyi rol phyogs mtshams thams cad na// rin chen 'od 'phro yid 'ong 'bar// de 'dra'i pho brang lhun gyis grub// pho brang de yi dbus de na// hrīḥyig dmar po las byung ba'i// pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba la// a las dkar gsal zla ba'i steng*// bai yig gser gyi mdog can las// nor bu'i rgyal mtshan bai yis mtshan// de yi 'od kyis 'phags pa mchod// sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bsal// slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las// rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras// ser po gser gyi ri ltar brjid// seng ge dkar mo nyal thabs steng*// rol pa'i 'dug stangs 'gyings bag bzhugs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis bzhin 'dzum zhing*// cung zad khro ba'i nyams kyis sgeg

/phyag g.yas yid bzhin rgyal mtshan dang*// g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin// dbu la rin chen cod paṇa bcings// sku la rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// lhab lhub dar gyi na bza' gsol// phrag gong g.yas g.yon nyi zlas brgyan// zhal nas rin chen char pa 'bebs// skye dgu'i dbul ba bsal phyir bzhugs// mgon po de yi mdun g.yas su// dzaṃ yig nyi ma shar 'dra las// nor bdag ār+ya dzaṃ bha la// sku mdog gser gyi 'od ltar 'bar// dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// ut+pal phreng ba'i do shal bsrel// phyag g.yas 'dod 'byung nor bu dang*// g.yon pas nor rkyal ne'u le bsnams// zhabs gnyis rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis// gter bum chen po'i gdan la bzhugs// nor lha de yi g.yon phyogs su// hrīḥyig gser gyi mdog can las// g.yang gi lha mo nor rgyun ma// mdzes sdug dzam+bu gser gyi mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum zhing sgeg /mchog sbyin 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum phyed krung bzhugs// 'khor sa dang po'i phyogs mtshams kyi// rin chen khang brtsegs brgyad kyi nang*// gnod sbyin rta bdag chen po brgyad// shar du rmugs 'dzin gser ltar ser// phyag g.yas 'dod 'byung nor bu bsnams// lho ru gang ba bzang po ser// ci 'dod gter gyi bum pa 'dzin// nub phyogs nor bzang zla ba'i mdog /nor bu 'bar bas lag g.yas mdzes// byang na lus ngan mig sman mdog /sngo bsangs ral gri mkha' la 'phyar// shar lhor yang dag shes pa ni// gur gum mdog can ral gri bsnams// lho nub 'brog gnas char sprin mdog /rin chen mdung dar dmar po 'phyar// nub byang lngas rtsen ser skya ste// rin chen khang bu brtsegs pa 'dzin// byang shar pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li// mthing ga gri dang rgyab na phub// rta bdag chen po brgyad rnams ni// g.yas pas rang rang lag cha dang*// g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le bsnams// rin chen cod paṇa rgyan cha dang*// lhab lhub dar gyi na bzas bklubs// dpa' zhing brjid la mi sdug gzugs// rang rang mdog mtshungs lta la bcibs// pho brang bar gyi khyams dag na// klu yi rgyal po nor rgyas sogs// klu chen nor lha brgyad po ni// sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun ldan// sku stod mi lus sku /dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi nas// phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i lha mo ser// ser mo 'bum dang bcas pas kyang*// g.yas na 'gugs byed lcags kyu dang*// g.yon na bstim byed bum pa 'dzin// lcags kyus khug la bum par stims// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir= /dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi nas// g.yang gi lha mo dmar mo ni// dmar mo 'bum dang bcas pas kyang*// g.yas na 'gugs byed lcags kyu dang*// g.yon na bstim byed bum pa 'dzin// lcags kyus khug la bum par stims// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir= /dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /nyi ma byang phyogs pha gi nas// phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i lha mo ljang*// ljang mo 'bum dang bcas pas kyang*// g.yas na 'gugs byed lcags kyu dang*// g.yon na bstim byed bum pa 'dzin// lcags kyus khug la bum par stims// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir= /dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /nyi ma dbus phyogs pha gi na// g.yang gi lha mo smug mo ni// smug mo 'bum dang bcas pas kyang*// g.yas na 'gugs byed lcags kyu dang*// g.yon na bstim byed bum pa 'dzin// lcags kyus khug la bum par stims// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir= /dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// zhes brjod la/ 'di'i rjes su 'og gi hūm̐ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas// dbang sdud 'od kyi lcags kyu spros zhes pa nas/ brling bar mdzod ces pa'i bar blangs la sbrel te 'don no// gnyis pa phywa 'gugs kyi bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rgyal chen gyi thugs kar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rdo rje ser po'i lte bar bai yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig le mtshan pa'i mthar so so'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/

rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse la mchod pa'i sprin dpag tu med par spros pas rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa mchod pas mnyes nas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshe dang bsod nams mthu stobs/ dbang phyug dpal 'byor gzi brjid/ zas nor longs spyod la sogs pa'i phywa g.yang phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus nas bdag dang sbyin bdag rten rdzas rnams la bstim pas/ tshe dang bsod nams dang gzi brjid la sogs rgyas par byas/ gnas khang lung pa thams cad rin po che dang 'bru nor la sogs pa 'dod pa'i longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pas mer gyis khengs par bsams la/ thog mar yi dam gyi sngags cung zad bzlas/ de nas rgyal chen gyi sngags bzlas te/ gzungs ni/ tad+ya thā/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsi li ma ṇi bha dra/ tsi li tsi li ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ e h+ye hi tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ sarba ar+tha me sā dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ su dha ne/ su ra ṇe/ su ma ti/ su su ṣe/ hi li mi li swā hā/ snying po ni/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇā ya swā hā/ zhes pa ci nus bzlas/ nor lha yab yum gyi sngags ni/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā/ oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇi hūm̐ swā hā/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags ni/ oṃ dzam+bha lā ya swā hā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ ku bai rā ya swā hā/ oṃ saṃ pra dz+nyā nā ya swā hā/ oṃ gu has+thā nā ya swā hā/ oṃ pañci kā ya swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa la ye swā hā/ zhes pa rnams gtso bo'i bcu cha tsam bzlas pa'i mthar/

rgyal po chen po ngal bsos po 'khor dang bcas pas/ bdag dang sbyin bdag gis gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad la srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol lo// de dag gis ni dngos gzhi'i rim pa ste nyin grangs su byed na/ 'di'i rjes su tshogs 'khor dang*/ zhi drag gzhan ltar na chad mdo sogs rjes kyi cho ga rnams bya'o// nyin grangs mi byed pa'am nyi ma rjes ma'i nyin phywa sgo dbye ba sogs la 'jug go /gsum pa phywa sgo dbye zhing g.yang spel ba ni/ yon bdag yod na stan bzang por bzhag la/ rnal 'byor pa chas gos bzang po dang ldan pas rol mo gdangs dang bcas te/ phywa khu ye/ rgyal po chen po ngal bsos po// yab yum btsun mo sras dang 'bangs// 'khor dang bcas rnams dgongs su gsol// de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang*// dbang phyug dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phyir// phywa sgo gnyen po 'byed du gsol// phywa sgo gnyen po phye nas ni// phyi rol phywa g.yang dgug tu gsol// gnas khang 'di la bskyil du gsol// mi rgyud 'di la bstim du gsol// rten rdzas 'di la bstim du gsol// skye 'gro rnams la spel du gsol// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir= /dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'di ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// phywa khu ye/ shar gyi sgo ma lcags kyu ma// dkar mo zhi ba'i las mdzad ma// shar gyi sgo 'di 'byed du gsol// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir= /dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /lho yi sgo ma zhags pa ma// ser mo rgyas pa'i las mdzad ma// lho yi sgo 'di 'byed du gsol// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir= /dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /nub kyi sgo ma lcags sgrog ma// dmar mo dbang gi las mdzad ma// nub kyi sgo 'di 'byed du gsol// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir// dgos 'dod char du 'dir// tshe dang dpal ni 'dir// byang gi sgo ma dril bu ma// sngon mo drag po'i las mdzad ma// byang gi sgo 'di 'byed du gsol// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir=

/dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// sbyin bdag dpal ni 'phel bar mdzod// ces brjod/ de nas dkar mo lag g.yas kyi g.yab dar thogs te/ hūm̐ bdag mdun lha yi thugs ka nas// dbang sdud 'od kyi lcags kyu spros// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rgyal ba'i sras// tshe lha nor lha gter bdag gi /mkhyen brtse nus pa yon tan dang*// khams gsum snod bcud 'jig rten gyi// tshe bcud bsod nams gzi brjid stobs// mi nor longs spyod dbang phyug rnams// khab len dang phrad lcags phye ltar// tshur bsdus bdag mdun lha rnams dang*// g.yang rdzas la bstim sgrub khang gi /phyi nang 'dod dgus gtams par gyur// phywa khu ye/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad nas// phun sum tshogs pa'i phywa 'dir byon// shar phyogs rgya nag mi yul nas// mi mang 'phel ba'i phywa 'dir khug /lho phyogs rgya gar chos yul nas// dam chos dar ba'i phywa 'dir khug /nub phyogs ge sar dmag yul nas// g.yul las rgyal ba'i phywa 'dir khug /byang phyogs stag gzig nor yul nas// 'dod dgu nor gyi phywa 'dir khug /steng phyogs 'dod gzugs lha yul nas// gzugs mdzes lang tsho'i phywa 'dir khug /'og phyogs nor can klu yul nas// rin chen gter gyi phywa 'dir khug /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// sbyin bdag dpal kun 'phel bar mdzod// phyi nang theg pa'i chos kyi phywa// bstan pa rgyas pa'i phywa 'dir khug /bde ba'i sar phyin thar pa'i phywa// mkhas btsun grub pa'i phywa 'dir khug /tshe dpal mnga' thang 'dod pa'i phywa// srid pa'i phun tshogs phywa 'dir khug /rin chen 'bru dbyig nor gyi phywa// ci 'dod 'byung ba'i phywa 'dir khug /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// sbyin bdag dpal ni 'phel bar mdzod// rigs bzang mi 'chad mi yi phywa// dpa' mdzangs ldan pa'i phywa 'dir khug

/rta mang 'phel ba rta yi phywa// 'gro mgyogs bzhon pa'i phywa 'dir khug /khyu mang 'phel ba gnag gi phywa// grangs med phyugs kyi phywa 'dir khug /gang 'dod 'jo ba bzhon ma'i phywa// 'o bcud mang 'dzin phywa 'dir khug /ro bcud smin pa 'bru tshogs phywa// lo legs 'bru 'phel phywa 'dir khug /ngo tsha gcer skyob bgo ba'i phywa// dro 'jam bde ster phywa 'dir khug /lus srog 'tsho byed zas kyi phywa// ro bcud dme ba'i phywa 'dir khug /mi phyed rang srung go mtshon phywa// dgra las rgyal byed phywa 'dir khug /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// sbyin bdag dpal ni 'phel bar mdzod// sra zhing brtan pa sa yi phywa// theg pa che ba'i phywa 'dir khug /rlan cing gsher ba chu yi phywa// rgyun mi chad pa'i phywa 'dir khug /tsha zhing sreg pa me yi phywa// smin par byed pa'i phywa 'dir khug /yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi phywa// stobs dang ldan pa'i phywa 'dir khug /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// sbyin bdag dpal ni 'phel bar mdzod// 'pho 'gyur bral ba go 'phang phywa// ri rgyal lta bu'i phywa 'dir khug /kun tu gsal ba snyan pa'i phywa// nyi zla lta bu'i phywa 'dir khug /khyab bdag chen po dbang gi phywa// nam mkha' lta bu'i phywa 'dir khug /mi zad 'phel ba dpal 'byor phywa// dbyar mtsho lta bu'i phywa 'dir khug /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kun nas// bde dga' dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phywa// nyi ma bzhin du lham mer byon// zla ba bzhin du gsal ler byon// na bun bzhin du thibs ser byon// sbrang char bzhin du sil ler byon// deng 'dir sbyin pa'i bdag po yi// tshe dang bsod nams rigs brgyud 'khor// nor phyugs longs spyod thams cad ni// 'phel zhing rtag tu brling bar mdzod// de nas dngos grub bskul ba ni/

dbus kyi ri rab dang*/ 'byung bzhi'i bcud dang*/ phye mar mda' dar sogs phywa rdzas rnams sbyin bdag pho mo gang yod la lag stong ma lus par bkram nas gzung du bcug la/ brda sprod 'di ma brjod kyang chog mod/ spro na 'di skad brjod/ 'o khyed rnams dngos grub blang ba'i don du thugs gtad 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma 'di nyid rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras dang dzam+bha la dang*/ nor rgyun ma dang nor bdag gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa la/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ tshe lha nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang bcas par gsal ba de dag khyed rnams kyi spyi bor spyan drangs nas dngos grub bskul ba'i rkyen gyis/ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku'i cha dang zhal dang nor bu dang ne'u le dang phywa rdzas rnams las 'dod dgu'i longs spyod kyi char chen po phab nas dngos grub tu stsal bas/ khyed rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams stobs dang gzi brjid la sogs pa rgyas par byas/ gnas khang dang lung pa thams cad zas nor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang bar mos pa mdzod/ phywa khu ye/ bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas// tshe sbyin nor sbyin lha yi tshogs// rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras// dbul ba sel lha yab yum dang*// nor bdag gnod sbyin bye ba bcas// thams cad bdag la brtser dgongs nas// deng 'dir sbyin pa'i bdag po la// lus la mi shigs dngos grub stsol// ngag la 'gag med dngos grub stsol// sems la 'khrul med dngos grub stsol// yon tan zad med dngos grub stsol// phrin las mi nub dngos grub stsol// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol// bsod nams rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// bde skyid ldan pa'i dngos grub stsol// mi nor 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol// 'khor 'bangs rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// snyan grags rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// lo phyugs legs pa'i dngos grub stsol// rin chen 'bru 'phel dngos grub stsol// longs spyod rgya mtsho'i dngos grub stsol// mnga' ris yangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// dge chos 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol// ci bsam 'grub pa'i dngos grub kyis// sbyin bdag 'di la dbang bskur ro// da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca mi/

a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ zhes brjod cing gnas gsum du reg cing lag tu sbyin te dbang bskur/ dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams las cung zad re 'gyed cing*/ phywa bum gyi chang de snod gcig tu byo zhing dang por gang byung brtags nas mthar thams cad la 'gyed/ de'ang nor bu'i gzugs byung na nor 'phel/ nas byung na 'bru 'phel ba sogs shes par bya'o// de nas 'byor pa rgyas pa'i phyir rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gzugs re re nas thogs te/ phywa khu ye/ kun la dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i phywa// dbang gis bsgyur ba'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ tsakra rat+na maṅga la bha wa tu swā hā/ mun sel 'dod 'byung nor bu'i phywa// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bkra shis stsol// oṃ ma ṇi rat+na maṅga la bha wa tu swā hā/ thams cad kun bskyed btsun mo'i phywa// mdzes sdug dpal gyis bkra shis stsol// oṃ wa tī rat+na maṅga la bha wa tu swā hā/ phyi nang don 'grub blon po'i phywa// che srid brtan pa'i bkra shis stsol// oṃ ma ha ta rat+na maṅga la bha wa tu swā hā/ theg chen stobs ldan glang po'i phywa// stobs chen zil non bkra shis stsol// oṃ hasti rat+na maṅga la bha wa tu swā hā/ cang shes shugs ldan rta mchog phywa// bde chen bgrod pa'i bkra shis stsol// oṃ a shwa rat+na bha wa tu swā hā/ log rtogs dpung 'joms dmag dpon phywa// bdud las rgyal ba'i bkra shis stsol// oṃ khaḍ+ga rat+na maṅga la bha wa tu swā hā/ mi dbang 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi// rin chen sna bdun bkra shis mchog /deng 'dir bdag cag 'khor bcas la// bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog /ces dang gzhan yang bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod cing me tog gi char dbab bo// de nas yon mchod thams cad gtang rag gi tshogs la rol pa ni/ sngar bshams pa'i tshogs rdzas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ tshogs phud yi dam dang chos skyong gi gtor ma la bran te/

spro na phyag dang bcas te las kyi rdo rjes bla ma yi dam gyi drung du tshogs phud 'bul bar zhu zhes brjod/ thams cad kyis/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i sogs tshigs bcad dang*/ oṃ ma hā gu ru nī laṃ bā ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi radz+nyā pa ya ti/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba kār+ya sā dha a mo ghā ya swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis bla ma dang yi dam la bstab/ yi dam gzhan yin na'ang des 'gre/ yang chos skyong nor lha'i drung du tshogs phud 'bul bar zhu zhes dang thams cad kyis/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu sarba sid+dhim+me pra sogs btags pa gsum gyis rnam sras gtso 'khor thams cad la thun mong du 'bul/ de nas dpon slob sbyin bdag dang bcas pa la drangs nas longs spyad/ lhag ma bsdus la/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hās lhag mar dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin no zhes pas bsngos la rol mo dang bcas pas gtsang sar dor la sbyin bdag rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni/ chad mdo bstan skyong dgos pa rnams la ni 'dir byas/ gang ltar yang rjes chog gi mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ byin brlabs gong bzhin byas/ oṃ be shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra sngon 'gros mchod cing gong ltar bstod/ bstod pa bsdu na/ bai/ rgyal ba'i thugs rje sems can gyi// re ba bskang phyir zlos pa'i gar// 'dod dgu'i dpag bsam ngal bsos po// nor sbyin 'khor dang bcas la bstod// ces bstod/ rgyal po chen po ngal bsos po 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la srid zhi'i dge legs dang dpal 'byor thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dang yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags pa dang*/ rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs dang*/ med pa rnams la oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs dang*/

oṃ badz+ra muḥrten la ma bstims pa'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsams/ g.yang rdzas rnams las dngos grub kyi tshul du blangs la cung zad bza'/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis smon lam ci shes brjod/ rnam sras kyi rten gtor dang*/ ri rab rnams re zhig mdzod kyi phug la sogs par tshags bya'o// smras pa/ yid srubs kyis sprul lang tshos 'dod ldan yid// lho phyogs rlung gi tsha bas nyen pa bzhin// 'byor pas phongs la phrin las nor bu yi// mchog gi rgyal po 'di yod skal ba bzang*// re ba'i 'bras bu bde ster man ngag 'di'i// rjes 'gro yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal po las// gzhan pa'i mtshungs zla byed pos mig brgyad sprul// bltas pas ma mthong gnyid bral brdzu la zhugs// nor bu'i byi dor ji bzhin tshul 'di'i gzhung*// mi gsal tshig don shin tu gsal byas shing*// 'khrugs pa bsdebs 'os char du dngar byas pa'i// g.yang chog 'dod pa dgu yi char 'bebs bskrun// de tshe thog mtha' bar gyi bkra shis mtshan// zas nor longs spyod char pa rang rang gi /lang tsho phan tshun 'gran pas nyin re bzhin// yi ge'i 'dzum gzugs blta la lhags sam snyam// des bskyed dge ba'i dpag bsam lo 'dab ni// phyogs kyi khor yug khyab pa'i grib bsil du// skye bo kun gyi ngal 'tsho 'dod pa dgu'i// 'bras bu ci dgar longs su spyod gyur cig /ces pa phywa phrin nor bu'i mchog rgyal gyi g.yang skyob cho ga 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di ni gzhan la phan pa'i thugs can bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug pa'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis g.yang skyob kyi gzhung nor bu mchog rgyal gyi dgongs don ji lta ba bzhin cho ga'i lam du bkral ba la der mi gsal zhing med thabs med pa'i kha 'gengs dang go rim du bsdebs pa bcas te tshang zhing nyams su blang bde bar rnam byung gi lo'i chu stod zla ba ston pa shākya'i sras po lhums su zhugs pa'i dus tshes bkra shis pa'i nyin lhun grub steng gi chos grwar yongs su grub par bgyis ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig
